name: 77-layout-model-and-verification
body:
[77-layout-model-and-verification] CSS tied to real rendering

Desired behavior
Layout meaningful + usable at any width; prediction verified on the real render.

Executable contract
1. Every layout action → parent container, available width, padding/gap, element sizes, intrinsic/min/max limits, column count/behavior, content, wrapping modeled. Narrowing/widening effect + next UI state predicted.
2. normal flow, Flex or Grid by the real element relation: one-dimensional row/column → Flex usually sufficient; Grid for genuinely linked tracks. Columns shrink, wrap or change count per content + conditions. Card max-width needs a concrete function; effect on neighbors + intermediate widths checked; design spacing has a purpose.
3. Five base widths 360, 390, 768, 1024, 1440 CSS px = engineering starting set, not the support limit: an intermediate width change, both sides of touched breakpoints, long content, significant states also checked. Project requires narrower/wider → included.
4. After the change: deciding geometry measured, readable screenshots inspected, real interactions checked. Emptiness/clipping/overflow/wrong wrapping → cause in the container/limits found and fixed; result vs prediction.
5. Design transfer → project tokens for geometry, color, typography, spacing, effects; page/section in normal flow, reflowing. Absolute positioning = proven local layering/decoration, never a page fixed as an artboard. Exception needs an explicit recorded owner decision.

Tools and skills
Available web-inspector: measure_element/inspect_ancestors/get_computed_styles for geometry, visual_screenshot_for_humans inspected, check_visibility + a real action, console/network per scenario. Browser/layout skill read before work; the old three-width advice does not override these five. evaluate allowed for a deciding measurement.

Links: 71-user-intent-outcome, 73-tests-not-proof, 79-behavior-comments-and-contract, 81-engineering-invariants.

Anti-patterns
Random Grid/max-width; unintentional emptiness; two or five lucky screenshots as the whole adaptivity; blanket ban on Grid, max-width or meaningful spacing; fixed-size artboard as a page; raw board values instead of tokens.
